fluff.overview:
The Skåret assassins of the JàrnFòlk are among the least verifiable infantry forces reported in the Periphery. What little is known comes from ComStar Explorer Corps reports and crime scene evidence gathered in the Hanseatic League. The JàrnFòlk themselves are Deep Periphery traders and explorers of Rasalhague descent who settled four systems within the Vela Nebula during the twenty-fifth century. Their society maintains no standing army and fields no BattleMechs or combat vehicles, making the existence of trained kill teams all the more unusual.

Rumors that surfaced in the late 3060s describe Skåret operatives working in teams of three or more, employing sniper rifles for long-range kills and blades, pistols, and poison for close work. Their ability to evade detection suggests access to sneak suit technology rivaling that of DEST operatives. Some intelligence reports indicate that at least some Skåret are exiles from JàrnFòlk society who sell their skills to the highest bidder, though whether the assassins truly exist remains an open question.
